d.ko: "지구멸망 60초전!"은 만화같은 스토리의 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다. 만약 거대한 운석이 지구에 충돌하게 되어 당신의 인생이 60초밖에 남지않았다면...? 평소에 억누르던 욕망을 불사를 것인가.. 아니면 한그루의 사과나무를 심을 것인가..? 당신의 선택은?
d.en: Meteor 60 seconds! is a simple, fun, comic-like action game that simulates your life if there were a meteor heading towards Earth and you had 60 seconds to live. Do anything you want to do with your last 60 seconds, even if it's illegal! What about planting an apple tree?
d.zh: 地球灭亡前60秒!(Meteor 60 seconds!)，一个刺激，漫画式的动作游戏，让你亲身体会陨石撞地球后只有60秒可活的情景。你在这60秒会做些什么？你会做些非法的事情吗？你会种棵苹果树吗？

rv.t: 무료게임이라 나쁘지 않다. 그냥 한번 쯤 시간죽이기로 해보는 거 나쁘지 않은 듯.
지구 종말이 1분 남았는데 인간의 3대 욕구중에 하나는 풀어야지
It reminds me of those old Newgrounds flash games. I enjoyed it and had a lot of fun, plus it's free on top of that. There's also a bit of a plot to the story, so it's not just a sandbox game.
When a game only takes 60 seconds it's difficult to play it long enough to be allowed to review it. When it's funny and free, it's easy to recommend it.
I get the idea behind the game, but it just wasn’t for me. The concept is interesting, but I didn’t really enjoy the gameplay. Still, some people might like it for the different choices and endings.
最后种一棵永远长不大的苹果树 然后捡起棒球棒，让全垒打把陨石送回宇宙深处
好玩，只是结局分支少了点，期待更多组合和分支。。。
